exposure: diastasis of the rectus abdominis muscles (DRAM)
outcome: muscle thickness (MT) of the abdominal wall muscles at rest and during contraction
cohort: 30 postpartum women, 16 with DRAM and 14 without
finding: Postpartum women with DRAM had a significantly greater increase in muscle thickness of the superior region of the rectus abdominis muscle during contraction compared to those without DRAM.
